title: reel-factory sound.json cue sheet
description: Validated for real by lib/audio/cues.mjs (unknown kinds/events, licences, ranges are errors). See references/sound.md.

seed.description: Master seed. Each cue is seeded from hash(seed, cue.id), so adding a cue never changes another.

buses.description: Bus trim in dB applied at the mix. Defaults: vo 0, sfx -3, music -12, ambience -14, room -26.

ducking.description: Music + ambience duck under VO. Values outside the ranges are clamped with a warning.

space.description: Default reverb send per layer: { sfx: { preset, send_db } }. A cue overrides it with its own reverb, or reverb:false.

until.description: End of a bed / drop. Optional for one-shots.

kind.description: Synth kind (impact, creak, footsteps, drip, pluck, wind, rain, room_tone, heartbeat, breath, riser, sub_drop, stinger, whoosh, cicadas, bell, ring, crackle, shuffle, noise_swell, hum, slap, thump, underscore, drone, pad, piano_motif, strings_tension), the automation kind 'drop', or a free label for generated/library cues.

gain_db.description: Relative to the kind's default level.

binaural.description: false disables ITD/ILD for this cue.

tags.description: 'scare' = QA requires >= 0.5 s relative silence before it and checks event anchoring; 'accent' = an intended loudness spike; 'phone' = run the phone check on it.

source.description: library = a recorded file (yours, or fetched by scripts/sfx_fetch.mjs from a `query`); earshot = rendered locally by the earshot CLI (also generated + provider earshot).

provider.description: With source generated: 'earshot' is the only provider wired in.

query.description: Search words for scripts/sfx_fetch.mjs (Openverse, or your own index when library_index is set) or earshot request words. A cue with a query and no file is an error until sfx_fetch has run; the result lands in sound.lock.json.

library_index.description: Path (relative to the project) of an index written by scripts/sfx_index.mjs; sfx_fetch then searches it instead of Openverse (no network).

licences.description: Openverse licence allowlist for this cue. Default cc0, pdm, by. Nothing else is accepted (NC, ND, SA, unknown are always rejected).

want_dur_s.description: Preferred clip length for ranking (beds use the at..until span).

normalize_rms_db.description: File cues: scale the recording so its RMS (above -60 dBFS) is this many dBFS before gain_db. Library files otherwise play at their own level.

file.description: Required for generated/library/earshot: WAV path relative to the project (or filled from sound.lock.json when the cue has a query). With `until`, the file is trimmed or crossfade-looped to the span (params.loop_xfade_s, default 0.5).

licence.description: Required for generated/library/earshot (filled from sound.lock.json for fetched cues). Missing = error.
